'''Outer Curved Street''' was a street in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==History==
[[File:Labor_droids.png|thumb|left|250px|Another view of the street]]

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] traveled down this road en route to [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]. A [[GR-45 medium transport/Legends|GR-45 medium transport]] was illegally parked in the street at this time.<ref name="ItWoSWT" />
